mapper.select: SELECT i.*, wh.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, ow.owner_code AS ownerCode, ow.owner_name AS ownerName, p.product_code AS productCode, p.product_name AS productName, loc.location_type AS locationType, zone.zone_type AS zoneType FROM wms_inventory i LEFT JOIN wms_products p ON i.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN wms_cargo_owners ow ON i.owner_id = ow.id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouses wh ON i.warehouse_id = wh.id LEFT JOIN wms_storage_locations loc ON i.location_code = loc.location_code LEFT JOIN wms_storage_zones zone ON loc.zone_id = zone.id ${ew.customSqlSegment}
